statements.statement: The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia (I48.91, I49.9)
The patient reports persistent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
These symptomatic events have not been adequately characterized by standard short-term monitoring
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
